2457-4289-6705-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

728-7940--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

2021-2060-4565-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

997-1580-4871-7316.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2921-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2034-3276-5038-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Repeat as needed.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-2116-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Spiteful Squad enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-2116-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

997-2281-4681.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2842-3967-5170-6132.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

930-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

480-2921-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2511-3773-6972--112.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

141-1269-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-4050.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-2438-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-2438-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2646-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

632-1879-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1879-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

4927-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-654-1231-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4944-6576--113.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Equipment.
4944-6576--113.description:
Cast the Equipment by paying its mana cost.
When the Equipment enters the battlefield, Firion triggers, creating a token copy of the Equipment whose equip abilities cost {2} less to activate.
Activate the Equipment token's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Crackdown Construct.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Equipment's ability, attaching it to Crackdown Construct.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4068-6438.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

955-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
955-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1636-2034-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-2034-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

997-3388--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1799-2493-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding one mana of any color.
When Archaeomancer dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Archaeomancer from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Archaeomancer from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

940-1416-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
940-1416-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1732-2971-3617-3662-3904.notablePrerequisites: Initiate's Companion does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1732-2971-3617-3662-3904.description:
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Late to Dinner from your graveyard.
Declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first Finest Hour trigger, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Finest Hour trigger, untapping Initiate's Companion and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard.
Move to your second combat phase, and declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted ability triggers, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Late to Dinner and Time Walk from exile without paying their mana costs.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Late to Dinner, returning Izzet Chemister from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Food token.
Repeat each turn.

230-3002-4050-4893.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-3002-4050-4893.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {G}.
Repeat.

385-1778-2106-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mortarpod attached to Memnite.
Fighter Class is at least level two.
385-1778-2106-4763.description:
Activate Memnite by sacrificing it.
Memnite dies, triggering Koll, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Memnite ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.

1439-2719-3191-3890-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Protean Raider, adding {B}.
When Protean Raider dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Unearth and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, returning Protean Raider from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Kairi.
Repeat.

3263-3525-4028.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Zhur-Taa Druid.
Zhur-Taa Druid does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3525-4028.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura for {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

4112-4865.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

229-678.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
